【参考范文 · 176 词】写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
Nowadays more and more students are becoming increasingly aware of the importance of developing digital skills. This awareness is well founded, for in an age reshaped by technology, the ability to handle digital tools has become as basic as reading and writing.
There are solid reasons behind this trend. For one thing, digital competence directly boosts academic efficiency. In my own case, learning to use spreadsheets and reference software turned a painful week of manual data sorting into an afternoon's work. Moreover, such skills open doors in the job market. For instance, a classmate who taught herself basic programming stood out among hundreds of applicants and landed an internship at a tech firm. As a result, students who master these tools gain a clear edge both in study and in career.
In conclusion, the growing attention to digital skills reflects a genuine need rather than a passing fashion. Students would be wise to invest time in mastering practical tools instead of waiting until graduation, so that they can thrive in a world that runs on technology.

lines.en: W: Welcome to Money Matters, a weekly program that helps you manage your money. Tonight, I'll be talking to Mary Johnson about budgeting.
lines.zh: W: 欢迎收听《金钱 matters》，这是一档每周播出的、帮助你管理资金的节目。今晚，我将和玛丽·约翰逊聊聊如何制定预算。

lines.en: M: Hello, everyone.
lines.zh: M: 大家好。

lines.en: W: There's a magic about money. When it's not planned for, tracked and kept a record of, it literally disappears. What are some of the steps we can take to prevent this from happening?
lines.zh: W: 钱有一种魔力。如果事先不做规划、不进行追踪，也不留存记录，它真的会凭空消失。我们可以采取哪些措施来防止这种情况发生呢？

lines.en: M: Well, it's all about keeping track of your money. If you don't do that, you'll never be able to set any goals for your budget or have the discipline to stick to them.
lines.zh: M: 嗯，关键就是要记录你的资金收支。如果你不这么做，就永远无法为预算设定目标，也没有自律坚持下去。

lines.en: W: That's easier said than done. I read recently that only 41% of Americans adhere to a budget.
lines.zh: W: 说起来容易做起来难。我最近读到一份资料，说只有41%的美国人会遵守预算。

lines.en: M: Yes, but knowing what you earn and what you spend can give you reassurance that you won't get into debt in the first place. You can do this by adding up all of your sources of income you have and writing them all down on a piece of paper. On the same page, write down all of your monthly expenses.
lines.zh: M: 是的，但了解自己的收入和支出，可以让你放心，至少一开始不会陷入债务。你可以把所有收入来源加起来，并全部写在一张纸上。在同一页上，写下每月的所有开支。

lines.en: W: I'm always amazed at how much my expenses add up. But designating each item as an income or an expense really helps me have a much better sense of all my spending.
lines.zh: W: 我总是惊讶于自己的开支加起来竟然那么多。但把每一项分别标记为收入或支出，确实能让我更清楚地了解自己的全部花费。

lines.en: M: Right, most people have no idea how much they spend each day, let alone each week or month, no matter how careful they are. Next, subtract your monthly expenses from income. If the result is positive, you are living within your means. If the result is a negative number, you're going to have to cut back on your spending.
lines.zh: M: 没错，大多数人根本不知道自己每天花了多少钱，更不用说每周或每月了，不管他们自认为多么谨慎。接下来，用收入减去每月的开支。如果结果是正数，说明你的生活没有超出自己的经济能力。如果结果是负数，你就得减少开支了。

lines.en: W: I'm usually a negative number. I just can't resist the allure of all those prestigious goods.
lines.zh: W: 我通常都是负数。我就是抵挡不住那些名牌商品的诱惑。

lines.en: M: Well, it's not a catastrophe. But you do have to make some changes. Try cutting back on those non-essential items, sell some stuff in your attic, or shop online to avoid unnecessary temptations like chocolate. Failing that you can always find yourself a part-time job.
lines.zh: M: 嗯，这还不至于造成灾难。但你确实得做出一些改变。试着减少购买那些非必需品，卖掉阁楼里的一些东西，或者在网上购物，以避免巧克力之类不必要的诱惑。如果这些办法都不奏效，你还可以找一份兼职。

lines.en: M: Hi there, I've come to see the flat. My name is Mark Adams. We spoke on the phone on Wednesday.
lines.zh: M: 你好，我是来看这套公寓的。我叫马克·亚当斯。我们周三通过电话。

lines.en: W: Hi, Mark, come on up. I'll buzz you in. Green door on the second floor on the right side. Nice to meet you, I spoke to all your references and they all checked out okay. So let me show you around. The place actually belongs to my mother, but her health isn't great, so we finally managed to persuade her to move in with us and rent this old place out.
lines.zh: W: 你好，马克，上来吧。我给你开门。二楼右手边的绿门。很高兴见到你，我联系过你提供的所有推荐人，他们的情况都没有问题。我带你四处看看吧。这套房子其实属于我母亲，但她的身体状况不太好，所以我们终于说服她搬来和我们一起住，把这套老房子租出去。

lines.en: M: It's a great size. Plenty of space. Very versatile. I think it's a winner for us.
lines.zh: M: 面积很大。空间充足，用途也很灵活。我觉得这套房子很适合我们。

lines.en: W: Yes, all the appliances are brand-new. There's a washing machine and a tumble dryer in the utility room next to the kitchen.
lines.zh: W: 是的，所有家电都是全新的。厨房旁边的杂物间里有一台洗衣机和一台烘干机。

lines.en: M: Lots of closet space too, which is fabulous. My wife has a ridiculous number of shoes. Now, the big question: What about noise and the neighbours?
lines.zh: M: 衣柜空间也很大，这太棒了。我妻子的鞋子多得离谱。现在，最关键的问题是：噪音和邻居怎么样？

lines.en: W: Well, all the neighbours are elderly, so no noisy kids. And the back of the house overlooks a clear and peaceful pond, so it's perfect if tranquility is what you are looking for.
lines.zh: W: 嗯，所有邻居都是老年人，所以没有吵闹的孩子。而且房子的后面俯瞰着一个宁静清澈的池塘，如果你们追求安静，这里就再合适不过了。

lines.en: M: That's good news. We've been living in a less than glamorous part of Aberdeen, constantly harassed day and night by noisy neighbours. Getting to work was a nightmare too, as we only have one car and my wife has to use it as she works nights at the hospital.
lines.zh: M: 那真是个好消息。我们一直住在阿伯丁一个不太体面的地方，日夜不停地被吵闹的邻居骚扰。上下班也像是一场噩梦，因为我们只有一辆车，而我妻子在医院上夜班，必须用那辆车。

lines.en: W: Well, if you like the place, it's yours, as soon as I get a contract drawn up with the solicitor. The first month's rent and a deposit are mandatory on signing the contract. Then we can work out when is the best day for you to pay rent each month.
lines.zh: W: 好吧，只要你喜欢这里，这套房子就是你的，等我让律师拟好合同就可以了。签合同的时候必须支付第一个月的房租和押金。然后我们可以商量一个最适合你每月交房租的日子。

lines.en: M: We'll be incredibly happy to be your new tenants. Thank you so much, My wife will be thrilled to get out of the shabby place we are now in, and start filling those wardrobes with all those shoes.
lines.zh: M: 我们会非常高兴成为你的新房客。太谢谢你了。我妻子一定会很开心能离开我们现在住的那个破旧地方，开始把那些衣柜塞满鞋子。

lines.en: A new study has found a positive correlation between how much television children watch and their parents' stress levels. Why? Because the more television kids watch, the more they're exposed to advertising. The more advertising they see, the more likely they are to insist on purchasing items when they go with their parents to the store. This could generate conflict if the parents refuse. All that, researchers say, can contribute to parents' overall stress levels.
lines.zh: 一项新研究发现，儿童看电视的时间长短与其父母的压力水平呈正相关。为什么？因为孩子看电视越多，接触到的广告就越多。他们看到的广告越多，和父母一起去商店时，就越有可能坚持要求购买某些商品。如果父母拒绝，这可能会引发冲突。研究人员表示，所有这些因素都可能导致父母的整体压力水平上升。

lines.en: What's the solution? Perhaps the most obvious is curtailing screen time. Commercial content is there for a reason: to elicit purchasing behavior. So parents might want to shut off the TV. Researchers concede that this is easier said than done. So they suggest another option. Parents can change how they talk to their kids about purchases.
lines.zh: 解决办法是什么？也许最明显的办法是限制屏幕使用时间。商业内容之所以存在，是有其原因的：诱导人们进行购买。因此，家长可能会想关掉电视。研究人员承认，这说起来容易做起来难。因此，他们提出了另一种选择。家长可以改变与孩子谈论购买行为的方式。

lines.en: The researchers suggest that parents seek input from their children on family purchasing decisions. They shouldn't try to control all purchases. Instead, parents might tell their children things like "I will listen to your advice on certain products or brands." This type of communication, the researchers assert, can lead to children making fewer purchasing demands. That means less parents' stress.
lines.zh: 研究人员建议，家长在家庭购买决策中征求孩子的意见。他们不应试图控制所有购买行为。相反，家长可以对孩子说：“我会听取你对某些产品或品牌的建议。”研究人员断言，这种沟通方式可以减少孩子提出购买要求的次数。这意味着父母的压力会减轻。

lines.en: However, the protective effect of this kind of communication diminishes with greater exposure to television. This is because advertising aimed at children is especially persuasive. Advertisers use an assortment of tactics, such as bright colors, happy music and celebrity endorsements to appeal to children. Plus, children don't have the cognitive ability to fully understand advertising's intent. That makes them particularly vulnerable to advertisements.
lines.zh: 然而，随着接触电视的增多，这种沟通方式的保护作用会减弱。这是因为针对儿童的广告尤其具有说服力。广告商会运用各种策略吸引儿童，例如鲜艳的色彩、欢快的音乐和名人代言。此外，儿童还不具备充分理解广告意图的认知能力。这使他们特别容易受到广告的影响。

transcripts.head: Questions 12 to 15 are based on the passage you have just heard.

lines.en: Everyone is supposed to cheer for good guys, and we should only punish the bad guys. But that's not what we always do. Most of the time, we do indeed reward good people. We also often punish people who harm others, or who aren't good team players. But sometimes, the good guys also get punished or criticized, specifically because they are so good.
lines.zh: 人人都应该为好人喝彩，而我们也只应该惩罚坏人。但我们并不总是这样做。大多数时候，我们确实会奖励好人。我们也经常惩罚那些伤害他人或不善于团队合作的人。但有时，好人也会受到惩罚或批评，正是因为他们太优秀了。

lines.en: This seems baffling, because it's detrimental to group cooperation. However, the phenomenon has been discovered in multiple fields, and it has been found in every society. Why does this happen? Research suggests a simple reason. When one person looks really good, others look bad by comparison. Those others then have an incentive in stopping that person from looking good, especially if they can't or won't compete. After all, we're all judged in comparison with others.
lines.zh: 这似乎令人费解，因为这种做法不利于群体合作。然而，这一现象已在多个领域被发现，并且存在于每一个社会中。为什么会发生这种情况？研究表明，原因很简单。当一个人表现得非常出色时，相比之下，其他人就显得很差。于是，那些人便有动机阻止这个人继续显得优秀，尤其是在他们无法或不愿与之竞争的情况下。毕竟，我们都会在与他人的比较中受到评判。

lines.en: When faced with someone better, what can a normal person do? One option is to actively compete. A second option is to bring that person down; that is, to suppress their cooperation or work ethic, infer selfish motives for their actions, or imply real or imagined hypocrisy. Other tactics include attacking them on unrelated dimensions, or punishing them outright.
lines.zh: 面对一个比自己优秀的人，一个普通人能做什么？一种选择是积极竞争。第二种选择是拉低那个人，也就是说，压制其合作意愿或工作积极性，把他们的行为推断为出于自私动机，或者暗示他们存在真实或想象中的虚伪。其他策略还包括在无关的方面攻击他们，或者干脆惩罚他们。

lines.en: Why does this matter? Critics often attack the motives of people who protect the environment, donate money, or work too hard. Such good deeds are dismissed as naive or hypocritical by those who do not perform those deeds. This criticism may ultimately discourage people from doing good deeds. So it's important to recognize these attacks for what they are.
lines.zh: 为什么这很重要？批评者经常攻击那些保护环境、捐款或工作过于努力的人的动机。那些不做这些事情的人，会把这些善举斥为天真或虚伪。这种批评最终可能会打击人们行善的积极性。因此，认清这些攻击的本质非常重要。

transcripts.head: Questions 16 to 18 are based on the recording you have just heard.

lines.en: In America, most researchers concede that boys and girls are brought up in different ways, taught different skills and rewarded for different acts. Women, it is agreed, excel at certain tasks, men at others. There's little argument that some personality traits appear more dominant in one sex than in the other. All of this notwithstanding, gender differences are very much in the media these days. Since the rise of the women's movement, gender role behavior has come under closer scrutiny. How has this affected friendship? How do the sexes differ in their friendship relations?
lines.zh: 在美国，大多数研究者承认，男孩和女孩以不同的方式被抚养长大，被教导不同的技能，并因不同的行为而受到奖励。人们一致认为，女性擅长某些任务，男性则擅长另一些任务。几乎没有人争辩说，某些人格特征在一个性别中比在另一个性别中表现得更为突出。尽管如此，性别差异如今在媒体上仍是一个热门话题。自妇女运动兴起以来，性别角色行为受到了更加密切的审视。这对友谊产生了怎样的影响？两性在友谊关系方面有何不同？

lines.en: Most preteen children have a best friend who is usually someone of the same sex and similar age. Both sexes share an essentially positive recollection of these childhood friendships; they do not differ in this respect. However, the type of play engaged in during these early friendships is telling of the difference to come. Boys tend to form play groups that are competitive in nature; girls' groups more frequently revolve around cooperative enterprises. Thus, at an early age, boys become concerned with trying hard and winning while girls, by contrast, play house and school, engaging in roles that require complementary support.
lines.zh: 大多数青春期前的儿童都有一个最要好的朋友，这个朋友通常与自己同性别且年龄相仿。两性对这些童年友谊都抱有基本上积极的回忆；在这一点上，他们并无不同。然而，在这些早期友谊中所进行的游戏类型，显示出日后差异的端倪。男孩往往组成具有竞争性质的游戏群体；女孩的群体则更经常围绕合作性活动展开。因此，在很小的年纪，男孩就开始关注努力争取和获胜，而女孩则相反，她们玩过家家和学校游戏，扮演需要彼此配合支持的角色。

lines.en: Speaking of their childhood, men recall being highly responsive to and aware of the gender-role opinions of other boys. Girls in preteen years appear to be less susceptible to gender-role pressure. It is not until the dating years that women report being concerned with feminine behavior. Males, for the most part, are responsive to the suggestion that their behavior is unmanly at almost any age.
lines.zh: 男性回忆童年时说，他们对其他男孩关于性别角色的看法高度敏感，也十分在意。青春期前的女孩似乎较少受到性别角色压力的影响。直到开始约会的年龄，女性才会表示自己开始关注女性化的行为。在几乎任何年龄，男性大多都会对他人暗示其行为不够男子气概作出反应。

lines.en: These early attitudes, reinforced by social conditioning, continue to play an active part in the friendships of both sexes during adolescence. This is a period when the majority of males once again report a close alliance with same-sex friends. Now, however, with heightened intensity, considerable energy is devoted to competing for position and a definite undercurrent of competition permeates the relationship. Although in dissimilar fashion, females share equally fragile relationships at this age. For them, the bond of loyalty extends only to the line of romantic involvement. This is most apt to be the case in late adolescence, when dating and relationships with boys take sharp precedence over sisterhood. Actually, dating dilutes the intensity of same sex friendships for men also. For the majority of us, the moment we begin to date seriously, there's a competition between romance and friendship.
lines.zh: 这些早期态度在社会环境塑造的强化下，在青春期继续积极影响着两性的友谊。这一时期，大多数男性再次表示自己与同性朋友结成了亲密联盟。然而此时，竞争的强度已经提高，大量精力被投入到争夺地位之中，竞争的明确暗流也渗透在这种关系里。尽管表现形式不同，女性在这个年龄段也同样拥有脆弱的关系。对她们而言，忠诚纽带只延伸到涉及恋爱的界限。青春期后期尤其容易出现这种情况，因为这时与男孩的约会和关系明显优先于女性之间的情谊。事实上，约会也会削弱男性同性友谊的亲密程度。对我们大多数人来说，一旦开始认真约会，浪漫关系与友谊之间就会形成竞争。

lines.en: Good afternoon. In today's lecture, we'll be talking about how and when to disclose a disability when applying for a job. On average, about 20% of the population has some form of disability. Most countries these days have equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws. Yet, disabled people often find it hard to decide when, how, and if at all to raise their disability problem with the potential employer. There is uncertainty about how a recruiter will perceive their disability.
lines.zh: 下午好。在今天的讲座中，我们将讨论求职时何时以及如何披露残疾状况。平均而言，大约20%的人口患有某种形式的残疾。如今，大多数国家都制定了平等机会和反歧视法律。然而，残疾人往往觉得很难决定何时、如何向潜在雇主提出自己的残疾问题，甚至难以决定是否要提出。关于招聘人员会如何看待他们的残疾，存在着不确定性。

lines.en: As such, many candidates fear they wouldn't be considered for a position, as a result of disclosing this personal information. And research has validated this as a genuine concern for many job applicants. It's a natural reaction, but it shouldn't be a reason to stay quiet. People need to remember that they are applying for a position they have the skills and experience to excel in. Discussing a disability with the potential employer may help them make reasonable workplace adjustments in their favor.
lines.zh: 正因如此，许多应聘者担心透露这一个人信息会导致自己不被职位考虑。研究证实，这确实是许多求职者真实存在的顾虑。这是一种自然反应，但不应成为保持沉默的理由。人们需要记住，他们申请的是一个自己具备胜任所需技能和经验的职位。与潜在雇主讨论残疾状况，可能有助于他们做出有利于求职者的合理工作场所调整。

lines.en: It's most appropriate to discuss a disability when they reply to confirm an interview. This information needn't be put up front in their cover letter or resumé, because it's probably not relevant to the position itself. Candidates with disabilities should feel they have the power to make their own decisions around sharing this information free from prejudice. If they find an organization that doesn't celebrate diversity and inclusion, it could say a lot about the company's culture. Perhaps the organization isn't the right fit. It's important for them to remember that they are seeking a manager and employer that's going to be supportive and continue to give them a great employment experience.
lines.zh: 在回复确认面试时讨论残疾状况是最合适的。这项信息无需事先写在求职信或简历中，因为它可能与职位本身无关。残疾应聘者应当感到自己有能力不受偏见影响，自行决定是否分享这一信息。如果他们发现某家机构不支持多元与包容，这能在很大程度上反映出该公司的文化。也许这家机构并不适合他们。对他们来说，重要的是要记住，他们寻找的是一位给予支持并能持续为他们提供良好工作体验的管理者和雇主。

lines.en: Companies sometimes offer candidates the chance to disclose disabilities on their application form, but people shouldn't feel restricted by this method or timing. People should avoid sharing the name of their disability or condition. There is always the risk that the recruiter will research information that is inaccurate or irrelevant. If people don't think their disability will impact their ability to perform in the advertised position, then it's entirely their entitlement to choose when, and whether to share this information.
lines.zh: 公司有时会在申请表上为应聘者提供披露残疾状况的机会，但人们不应感到受制于这种方式或时间。人们应当避免透露其残疾或病情的具体名称。招聘人员始终存在去查阅不准确或无关信息的风险。如果人们认为自己的残疾不会影响其在招聘岗位上的履职能力，那么选择何时以及是否分享这一信息完全是他们的权利。

lines.en: Smartphones distract attention and reduce learning because of their potential to offer activities more inviting than study. But what about background sound alone?
lines.zh: 智能手机可能提供比学习更具吸引力的活动，因此会分散注意力并降低学习效果。但仅有背景声音会怎样呢？

lines.en: A group of American researchers compared students' comprehension of verbal material when reading in the presence of background speech, instrumental music or general noise. General noise is neutral, such as that from the sound of an air conditioner or fan. Students' scores were most depressed in the presence of background speech. Comprehension was slightly better with the presence of music than with speech. However, when they were asked to identify melodies rather than understand text, background music interfered more. When the background speech was in a language unfamiliar to participants, there was little if any hindrance of reading comprehension.
lines.zh: 一组美国研究人员比较了学生在有背景语音、器乐或一般噪声的环境中阅读时对文字材料的理解情况。一般噪声是中性的，例如空调或风扇发出的声音。在有背景语音的情况下，学生的得分下降幅度最大。有音乐时的理解效果略好于有语音时。然而，当要求学生辨认旋律而不是理解文字时，背景音乐的干扰更大。当背景语音使用参与者不熟悉的语言时，对阅读理解几乎没有妨碍，或者说妨碍很小。

lines.en: British researchers compared the effects of background speech, vocal music, instrumental music, general background noise and silence on short-term memory. Background speech had the biggest negative effect; vocal music was slightly more disruptive than instrumental; and general background noise and silence were least disruptive. It seems the degree of interference from background noise depends on the overlap between the processing required on the task and the processing required to screen out the background noise.
lines.zh: 英国研究人员比较了背景语音、声乐、器乐、一般背景噪声和安静环境对短时记忆的影响。背景语音的负面影响最大；声乐的干扰略大于器乐；一般背景噪声和安静环境的干扰最小。背景噪声造成的干扰程度似乎取决于任务所需的加工过程与排除背景噪声所需的加工过程之间的重叠程度。

lines.en: The studies suggest that when people read and when they try to remember any verbal material, background speech will inhibit their ability. Instrumental music will have at worst a slight effect. When students write essays, however, other research has found it is best to reduce all background noise as much as possible.
lines.zh: 这些研究表明，当人们阅读或试图记忆任何文字材料时，背景语音会抑制他们的能力。器乐充其量只会产生轻微影响。然而，其他研究发现，学生写文章时，最好尽可能减少所有背景噪声。

lines.en: Not everyone reacts in the same way to distractions. Other studies suggest some aspects of personality may make a difference. The researchers subjected shy quiet people and confident outgoing ones to high arousal or low arousal background music, general noise or silence while asking them to remember words. Everyone performed best in the silent condition, but less sociable people were more negatively affected by each of the distractions. So when children are reading and trying to incorporate new material, parents could consider allowing some background music, particularly if it's instrumental and their child is the outgoing type.
lines.zh: 并非每个人对干扰的反应都相同。其他研究表明，个性中的某些方面可能会产生影响。研究人员让害羞安静的人和自信外向的人在高唤醒或低唤醒的背景音乐、一般噪声或安静环境中记忆词语。每个人在安静环境中的表现都最好，但不太合群的人受到每种干扰的负面影响都更大。因此，当孩子阅读并试图吸收新材料时，父母可以考虑允许播放一些背景音乐，尤其是在音乐为器乐且孩子性格外向的情况下。

analysis.定位: P3 When faced with someone better, what can a normal person do? One option is to actively compete. 面对比自己更强的人，一个普通人能做什么呢？一个选择是积极地去竞争。
analysis.信号: 设问后第一答 One option。录音用 what can a normal person do? 自设问，紧接 One option is to actively compete 给出第一个、也是唯一正面的做法；One option 是列举做法的起始信号，作者把「主动竞争」摆在首位，正是答案句。
analysis.替换: One option is to actively compete↔Compete with them activelycompete/actively 同义重组
analysis.排除: A)未提及「向他们认真学习」是面对强者最符合常识的反应，但录音列举的做法里只有竞争和打压，没有 learn；这是用常识替文本，录音根本没念。 C)未提及「暂时不理他们」录音从未提及，作者给的第二选择是 bring that person down（打压），不是回避；这是凭想象补的做法。 借用原文：A second option is to bring that person down D)原词陷阱选项「真诚地与他们合作」盗用了录音里 suppress their cooperation 的 cooperation 一词，但录音说的是「压制别人的合作」，方向恰恰相反，绝非自己去真诚合作。 借用原文：suppress their cooperation or work ethic

questions.stem: 【题目】 What may discourage people from performing good deeds?
questions.stem_zh: 什么可能阻碍人们做好事?

analysis.定位: P4 Such good deeds are dismissed as naive or hypocritical by those who do not perform those deeds. This criticism may ultimately discourage people from doing good deeds. 这样的善行被那些自己不做这些事的人贬斥为天真或虚伪。这种批评最终可能打消人们行善的念头。
analysis.信号: discourage 前一句即诱因。题干的 discourage 在 This criticism may ultimately discourage people from doing good deeds 原词复现，而 This criticism 回指上一句 dismissed as naive or hypocritical；指代回指处的那项批评（被斥为伪善）就是打击行善的因素，是答案句。
analysis.替换: dismissed as naive or hypocritical↔Being dismissed as hypocritical近义并保留 hypocritical
analysis.排除: B)张冠李戴「得不到应有回报」呼应录音前文 reward good people 的奖励话题，但那是开头铺垫，并非第 4 段 discourage 的诱因；把别段的内容安到本题头上。 借用原文：we do indeed reward good people C)未提及「不得不做太多牺牲」录音通篇没提 sacrifice，是对行善代价的常识联想；录音说的打击是被斥伪善，不是牺牲过多。 D)偷换概念「被周围人误解」听着像 dismissed as hypocritical，但「误解」是中性的认知偏差，录音说的是被恶意贬斥为伪善，程度与性质都不同，属把「被斥伪善」悄悄换成更轻的「被误解」。 借用原文：dismissed as naive or hypocritical by those who do not perform those deeds

questions.stem: 【题目】 What does the speaker say about most preteen children?
questions.stem_zh: 说话者关于大多数青春期前儿童说了什么？

analysis.定位: P2 Most preteen children have a best friend who is usually someone of the same sex and similar age. 大多数青春期前的孩子都有一个最好的朋友，这个朋友通常是同性、年龄相仿的。
analysis.信号: 总括词most + 段首点题。这句出现在第二段段首，且以题干同款的 Most preteen children 开头，是讲者对该群体的总括陈述；听到 most 这种总括词紧跟题目所问对象，就该锁定其后内容为答案句。
analysis.替换: a best friend who is usually someone of the same sex↔make friends with peers of the same sexhave a best friend概括为make friends
analysis.排除: A)原词陷阱gender differences 借用了第一段反复出现的 gender differences 一词，但那是讲者引出全文话题的背景，并非对 preteen children 的描述；说 preteen 孩子『越来越意识到性别差异』在该年龄段段落里并无对应。 借用原文：gender differences are very much in the media these days B)原词陷阱positive recollection 与录音 positive recollection of these childhood friendships 几乎原词照搬，极具迷惑性；但原文说的是『两性都对这些童年友谊有正面回忆』，主体是回忆童年的成年视角，并非在讲 preteen 孩子当下『正在进行正面回忆』这一行为，答非所问。 借用原文：Both sexes share an essentially positive recollection of these childhood friendships C)未提及see the importance of friendship 听上去合情合理，但录音在描述 preteen children 时只说他们有同性好友、玩不同性质的游戏，从未说他们『开始认识到友谊的重要性』，属于无中生有。

analysis.定位: P4 Now, however, with heightened intensity, considerable energy is devoted to competing for position and a definite undercurrent of competition permeates the relationship. 然而此时，随着强度增加，大量精力被投入到争夺地位上，一股明确的竞争暗流贯穿于这段关系之中。

analysis.替换: considerable energy is devoted to competing for position↔Competing for position几乎原词对应、仅句式调整

analysis.信号: 时间标志late adolescence + 优先级信号take precedence over。句中 in late adolescence 正是题干同款时间标志，紧跟 take sharp precedence over sisterhood 给出明确的优先级判断；时间标志加『谁优先于谁』信号叠加，即为答案句。
analysis.替换: dating and relationships with boys take sharp precedence over sisterhood↔prioritize romance over friendshiptake precedence over等于prioritize over

passages.en: The now extinct passenger pigeon has the dubious honor of being the last species anyone ever expected to disappear. At one point, there were more passenger pigeons than any other species of bird. Rough __(26)__ of their population went as high as five billion and they accounted for around 40 percent of the total indigenous bird population of North America in the early 19th century.
passages.zh: 如今已经灭绝的旅鸽，获得了一个颇为尴尬的“荣誉”：它是人类最不曾料想到会灭绝的物种。曾经，旅鸽的数量超过其他任何鸟类。对其数量的粗略估计最高达五十亿只；19世纪初，它们约占北美洲土著鸟类总数的40%。

passages.en: Despite their huge population, passenger pigeons were __(27)__ to human intrusion into their nesting territory. Their nests were shabby things and two weeks after the eggs __(28)__ , the parent pigeons would abandon their offspring, leaving them to take care of themselves. People discovered that these baby pigeons were really tasty, and the adult birds were also quite __(29)__ . First the Native Americans and then the transplanted Europeans came to consider the birds a great __(30)__ .
passages.zh: 尽管旅鸽数量庞大，但它们很容易受到人类侵入其筑巢领地的影响。它们的巢十分简陋，鸟蛋孵化两周后，亲鸟便会弃下幼鸟，任由它们自谋生路。人们发现这些幼鸽非常美味，成年旅鸽也相当可食用。起初是美洲原住民，后来又有迁居而来的欧洲人，都逐渐把这种鸟视为美味佳肴。

passages.en: By the 1850s, commercial trapping of passenger pigeons was proceeding at an __(31)__ pace. Hundreds of thousands of the birds were being harvested every day to be made into popular pigeon pies. In addition, large __(32)__ of the pigeons' nesting territory were being cleared away for planting crops and creating pasture land. As numerous as the passenger pigeons were, they were not an __(33)__ resource. By the 1880s, it was noticed that the bird population had become seriously __(34)__ . The last passenger pigeons killed in the wild were shot in 1899.
passages.zh: 到19世纪50年代，旅鸽的商业捕猎以前所未有的速度进行。每天有数十万只旅鸽被捕获，用来制作广受欢迎的鸽肉馅饼。此外，旅鸽大片的筑巢领地也被清理出来，用于种植农作物和开辟牧场。尽管旅鸽数量众多，但它们并不是取之不尽的资源。到19世纪80年代，人们注意到旅鸽的数量已经严重减少。在野外被杀死的最后几只旅鸽于1899年遭到射杀。

passages.en: Eventually those billions and billions of birds shrank to a single remaining __(35)__ , a passenger pigeon named Martha, who died on September 1,1914, in captivity at the Cincinnati Zoo. In addition to being the end of an era, it was also the first time humans were able to exactly time the extinction of a species.
passages.zh: 最终，那数十亿只旅鸽减少到仅剩一只，这只名叫Martha的旅鸽于1914年9月1日在辛辛那提动物园的圈养环境中死亡。这不仅标志着一个时代的结束，也是人类第一次能够准确确定一个物种灭绝的时间。

rows.text: L) estimates名词
主语位置的复数名词
估算数量的专用词 estimates of their population 即 "对其种群数量的估算"，与下文 went as high as five billion 给出一个具体估算上限完全对应，rough estimates 也是常见搭配。
K)excerpts搭配对象错 excerpts 是文章节选，对象为文本，不能修饰 population；且 rough excerpts 在英语里也不成搭配。
A) vulnerable形容词
were + ___ + to 表语形容词
vulnerable to 固定搭配 + 让步逻辑 be vulnerable to 是固定搭配 "易受……影响"；句首 Despite their huge population 已用 despite 标出让步，主句必须给出 "虽多却脆弱" 的反差，vulnerable 正合此意。
E)robust搭配 + 逻辑双错 robust 不与 to 搭配，且语义是 "强健的"，与 despite 让步要求的 "脆弱" 反转完全相反。
最具迷惑性的错误词是 E) —— 把 vulnerable 与 robust 看反。vulnerable 与 robust 都是描述生物的形容词，词义相反；只盯 "形容动物状态" 而忘了 Despite their huge population 的让步要求，就会反向填 robust；防坑口诀：despite 之后必反差。
I) hatched动词
时间状语从句缺谓语动词
鸟蛋孵化的固定搭配 主语是 the eggs，下一句又紧跟 the parent pigeons would abandon their offspring，逻辑链是 "蛋孵出 → 幼鸟出生 → 父母两周后弃之而去"，只有 hatched（孵化）能让这条链成立。
J)expired语义反了 expired 表 "死亡/失效"，若蛋死了下文就不存在 their offspring 让父母遗弃，前后矛盾。 N)depleted搭配错位 depleted 主语通常是资源/数量，不能说 "蛋被耗尽"；而且后文 the bird population had become seriously __(34)__ 才是它真正的归宿。
M) edible形容词
系动词 were 后接表语
与幼鸽好吃形成并列 前一句 People discovered that these baby pigeons were really tasty 已说幼鸽好吃，连词 also 表 "成鸟也……"，下一句又紧跟 came to consider the birds a great __(30)__ 把它们视作佳肴，edible（可食用的）与 "好吃/佳肴" 一脉相承。

A)vulnerable留给 27 题 vulnerable 在 passenger pigeons were __(27)__ to human intrusion 中与 to 形成 vulnerable to 固定搭配，是 27 题的标配，这里硬塞会让 27 题无解。 E)robust语义跑题 robust（强健的）与上下文 "可吃—佳肴" 这一主线无关，且后文紧接说人类把它们当美味，与 "强健" 没有逻辑承接。
O) delicacy名词
consider sb/sth + ___ 的宾补名词
与 tasty/edible 同色升级 前两句已铺垫 these baby pigeons were really tasty 和 the adult birds were also quite __(29)__ 即可食用，结论自然是把它们视为 a great delicacy（一道美味佳肴）。
F)refuge语义脱轨 refuge 指 "避难所"，与 "被吃掉" 的语境完全相反；把动物当 refuge 在逻辑上不通。
B) unprecedented形容词
冠词 + ___ + 名词作定语
前所未有的速度 下一句 Hundreds of thousands of the birds were being harvested every day 用 "每天数十万只" 直接量化了这种空前的捕猎规模，an unprecedented pace（以前所未有的速度）正与之匹配，且 at an unprecedented pace 是地道搭配。
H)infinite程度过头且搭配怪 infinite 指 "无限的"，pace 一旦无限就不再是速度而成悖论；且 infinite 更适合修饰 resource，将留给 33 题。
C) tracts名词
形容词 + 名词 + of 结构
大片土地的专用搭配 tracts of land 是固定表达，指 "大片土地"，与 large __(32)__ of the pigeons' nesting territory were being cleared away for planting crops and creating pasture land 中 "被开垦为农田和牧场" 的语境严丝合缝。
G)plazas语义场不符 plazas 指 "城镇广场"，是城市建筑用语，无法描述森林/筑巢地被砍伐开垦的乡野场景。 K)excerpts对象错配 excerpts 指 "文章节选"，对象是文本而非土地，与 nesting territory 不搭配。
H) infinite形容词
an + ___ + 名词的形容词

无穷资源呼应数量再多也有尽 前半句让步 As numerous as the passenger pigeons were 与主句 "they were not an __(33)__ resource" 形成转折，逻辑应为 "虽多但并非用之不竭"，infinite resource（无尽资源）正是这个反转点；且为下文 the bird population had become seriously __(34)__ 的锐减做铺垫。
M)edible可食用不构成逻辑反转 edible resource（可食用资源）与前半句 "数量众多" 之间不形成 "虽多但不取之不尽" 的让步—转折逻辑，且 edible 真正用武之地在 29 题描述成鸟。
最具迷惑性的错误词是 M) —— 无视让步逻辑只挑元音。33 题 they were not an __(33)__ resource 中 an 让 M edible 和 H infinite 都满足元音条件，若忽略前半 As numerous as the passenger pigeons were 的让步逻辑，很容易误填 edible；防坑：看到 As…as 让步必找反义。
N) depleted形容词
had become + 副词 + ___
数量被大量耗减 上文 Hundreds of thousands of the birds were being harvested every day 加上大片栖息地被砍伐，必然导致种群锐减；depleted 表 "被耗尽/锐减的"，与下文 The last passenger pigeons killed in the wild were shot in 1899 的灭绝倒计时呼应。
D) specimen名词
形容词 + 名词作宾语
仅存的个体/标本 同位语 a passenger pigeon named Martha 把空位释义为 "一只名叫 Martha 的旅鸽"，specimen 在生物学语境下正好表 "个体/标本"，与 "the last passenger pigeons killed in the wild" 后所剩唯一一只的画面相称。
F)refuge语义指向偏离 refuge 指 "避难所"，是地点概念，无法被同位语 "a passenger pigeon named Martha" 解释，且与 shrank to a single 的 "萎缩到一只" 这个个体数概念不匹配。

longreading.title: 2022年9月·第1套 英语六级长篇阅读（信息匹配） 第 1 篇 · 36–45 题答案与解析

passages.en: A) As computer coding has become an increasingly sought-after skill, more K-12 schools are working it into their curriculums. Some states have considered allowing students to forgo(放弃) foreign language for coding classes, despite opposition from educators.
passages.zh: 随着计算机编程日益成为备受追捧的技能，越来越多的幼儿园至高中学校将其纳入课程体系。尽管教育工作者表示反对，一些州仍考虑允许学生以编程课替代外语课。

passages.en: B) There's a debate over whether it's appropriate to teach coding in elementary schools, with fierce opinions on each side. When it comes to allowing coding to fill foreign language requirements, though, most educators agree: Coding should be added to curriculums, but not at the expense of foreign language classes.
passages.zh: 小学是否适合教授编程一直存在争议，双方的意见都十分强烈。不过，就允许编程课满足外语学习要求而言，大多数教育工作者都认同一点：编程应当被纳入课程体系，但不应以牺牲外语课为代价。

passages.en: C) The idea is that computer programming is a language, allowing people to communicate with machines and programs. It's the language of the 21st century and more valuable than a natural language, some advocates argue. The computer science field is growing faster than schools can keep up because of budget constraints and a lack of skills training for teachers.
passages.zh: 这种观点认为，计算机编程是一种语言，使人们能够与机器和程序交流。一些倡导者认为，这是21世纪的语言，比自然语言更有价值。由于预算限制以及教师缺乏技能培训，计算机科学领域的发展速度快于学校所能跟上的速度。

passages.en: D) According to the 2016 U.S. News/Raytheon STEM Index, computer science jobs have helped boost wages in the U.S., and computer-related jobs hold the top seven positions in STEM fields for highest number of workers. Foreign language interest, on the other hand, is declining for the first time since 1995. The number of higher education language enrollments declined between 2009 and 2013 by more than 111,000 spots, according to the Modern Language Association of America.
passages.zh: 根据《美国新闻与世界报道》/雷神公司的《2016年美国STEM指数》，计算机科学相关工作帮助推动了美国工资水平的提高，而在STEM领域中，按从业人员数量计算，计算机相关工作占据了排名最高的七个职位。另一方面，自1995年以来，人们对外语的兴趣首次出现下降。据美国现代语言协会统计，2009年至2013年间，高等教育阶段的语言课程注册人数减少了11.1万多人。

passages.en: E) "I think the opportunity to give people a choice is important," says Florida state Senator Jeremy Ring, who introduced a bill last year that would allow Florida students to choose between foreign language and coding classes for the purpose of university admissions requirements, "I think if you're going to give two years of language in high school, you might as well do computer coding."
passages.zh: 佛罗里达州参议员杰里米·林说：“我认为，给人们提供选择的机会很重要。”他去年提出一项法案，允许佛罗里达州学生在外语课和编程课之间进行选择，以满足大学招生要求。“我认为，如果你打算要求学生在高中学习两年语言，那还不如学习计算机编程。”

passages.en: F) The Florida bill died this year after passing 35:5 in the state Senate when the full Legislature failed to take action. It would have been the first state to try this initiative. Ring says that although he will be out of office, an identical bill will be reintroduced within the next year by others on his behalf. "In the speech I gave on the Senate floor, I said, 'We can be the first state to do this, or we can be the 50th state to do it. It's our choice. It's going to happen,'" Ring says.
passages.zh: 佛罗里达州的法案在州参议院以35比5的结果获得通过后，因全体州议会未采取行动而于今年夭折。它本来会成为首个尝试这一举措的州。林说，尽管他将离任，但其他人会代表他在未来一年内重新提出一项内容相同的法案。林说：“在我于参议院发表的演讲中，我说：‘我们可以成为这样做的第一个州，也可以成为第五十个州。这是我们的选择。这件事终将发生。’”

passages.en: G) A Kentucky bill similar to the one in Florida was met with complaints from educators, and was then amended to promote computer science education initiatives with no mention of foreign language requirements. Instead, the state will provide support for higher quality certified teachers for programming classes. Under the Washington bill, public universities would accept two years of computer science classes in place of two years of foreign language for admission purposes. A report detailing the opinions of state university officials is due to the Legislature by November 2017.
passages.zh: 一项与佛罗里达州法案类似的肯塔基州法案遭到教育工作者的投诉，随后被修改为推动计算机科学教育举措，不再提及外语要求。相反，该州将为编程课程提供支持，以聘用质量更高、经过认证的教师。根据华盛顿州的法案，公立大学在招生时将接受两年计算机科学课程，以替代两年外语课程。州立大学官员意见的详细报告须在2017年11月前提交给州议会。

passages.en: H) Texas passed a bill in 2013 that allows students to substitute computer coding only after they have attempted and performed poorly in a foreign language class. Srini Mandyam, CTO and co-founder of kid-friendly instructional coding company Tynker, believes allowing students to forgo foreign language because they struggle with it is unproductive because every subject, whether art, math or language, is a significant contribution to a well-rounded existence. "Many students don't fare well with algebra but we never discuss eliminating it or … say chemistry is now counted as an algebra class," he said via email. "We teach algebra because it's important and we should teach foreign language and coding for the same reason. Exposure to a wide breadth of subjects and material results in well-rounded students who are able to make informed decisions … about what they want to pursue."
passages.zh: 得克萨斯州于2013年通过一项法案，允许学生只有在尝试学习外语课程且成绩不佳之后，才能用计算机编程替代外语课程。面向儿童的编程教学公司Tynker的首席技术官兼联合创始人斯里尼·曼迪亚姆认为，允许学生因为外语学习困难而放弃外语是没有成效的，因为无论是艺术、数学还是语言，每一门学科都对全面发展作出了重要贡献。他在电子邮件中说：“许多学生代数成绩不好，但我们从未讨论过取消代数，也不会说化学课现在可以算作代数课。我们教授代数，是因为它很重要；出于同样的原因，我们也应当教授外语和编程。接触广泛的学科和材料，能够培养全面发展的学生，使他们能够就自己想要学习的方向作出明智的决定。”

passages.en: I) Computer science courses already fulfill a math or science high school graduation requirement in 28 states and the District of Columbia, up from only 12 states in 2013. And while advocates of the bills say they should count as foreign language instead, opponents stress the importance of balancing computer and foreign language skills.
passages.zh: 在28个州和哥伦比亚特区，计算机科学课程已经可以满足高中毕业所需的数学或科学课程要求，而2013年时这一数字还只有12个州。法案的倡导者认为，计算机科学课程应当改为计入外语要求，但反对者强调，平衡计算机技能与外语技能十分重要。

passages.en: J) Studies show that bilingualism(双语) correlates with cognitive development, intelligence, memory and problem solving abilities, according to the American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages. A 2007 study showed that foreign language students outperformed their non-foreign language peers on standardized tests after only two to three years of study. And while a 2014 report from German and American universities suggests that programmers are using language (but not mathematical) regions of the brain when understanding code, critics remain wary. They say that regardless of cognitive functions, being monolingual is a disadvantage in the increasingly international economy, even if English has become the de facto(事实上的) language of business.
passages.zh: 根据美国外语教学委员会的说法，研究表明，双语能力与认知发展、智力、记忆力和解决问题的能力相关。一项2007年的研究显示，外语学习者只经过两到三年的学习，在标准化考试中的表现就超过了未学习外语的同龄人。尽管德国和美国高校于2014年发布的一份报告表明，程序员在理解代码时使用的是大脑中与语言有关的区域，而不是与数学有关的区域，但批评者仍持谨慎态度。他们认为，无论认知功能如何，在日益国际化的经济环境中，只会一种语言都是一种劣势，即使英语已经成为事实上的商业语言。

passages.en: K) "Our world is shrinking but its problems are really growing," says ACTFL National Language Teacher of the Year Ted Zarrow, who teaches high school Latin in Westwood, Massachusetts, and has also studied Spanish, French, German, Italian and Greek. "We need to find a way to put ourselves at the global table and to treat each other with mutual respect. And learning languages allows us to do that because language is not part of culture, language is culture."
passages.zh: 在马萨诸塞州韦斯特伍德教授高中拉丁语、同时还学习过西班牙语、法语、德语、意大利语和希腊语的美国外语教学委员会年度语言教师特德·扎罗说：“我们的世界正在缩小，但其中的问题却在不断增加。我们需要找到一种方式，让自己参与全球事务，并以相互尊重的态度对待彼此。学习语言能够帮助我们做到这一点，因为语言不是文化的一部分，语言就是文化。”

passages.en: L) Even with the benefits and skill sets languages provide, recruiters and employers value computer skills more. According to the National Association of Colleges and Employers' 2016 report, study abroad and foreign language fluency were not very influential in the employee hiring processes, but 55 percent of employers looked for computer skills on applicants' resumes. However, although 2016 computer science graduates can expect to make the second highest starting salary compared with other jobs this year, the Bureau of Labor predicts the demand for computer programmers will decrease 8 percent or by 26,500 jobs by 2024.
passages.zh: 尽管语言能够带来诸多益处和技能组合，但招聘人员和雇主更加看重计算机技能。根据美国大学与雇主协会的《2016年报告》，留学经历和外语流利程度在员工招聘过程中并没有产生很大影响，但55%的雇主会在求职者的简历中寻找计算机技能。然而，尽管2016年的计算机科学毕业生预计将获得本年度各类工作中第二高的起薪，美国劳工统计局预测，到2024年，对计算机程序员的需求将下降8%，即减少26,500个职位。

passages.en: M) Ring says foreign language skills are important, but expresses doubt that school districts could work both coding and language into their curriculum in a significant way because they lack the time in the school day. "Nothing against language," he says. "I just think it's something you have to start early and not just have something that you do for a couple of years in high school," he says.
passages.zh: 林说，外语技能很重要，但他怀疑学区能否在课程中以充分的方式同时安排编程和语言学习，因为学校每天的教学时间有限。他说：“我并不是反对语言。我只是认为，语言学习必须尽早开始，而不应只是在高中学习几年。”

passages.en: N) Zarrow agrees that foreign language education should begin earlier, but says it is possible to work both computer programming and foreign language learning into schools evenly. He suggests an immersive, dual language program where students spend half the day in English and half the day in another language, as several schools around the country have successfully implemented. "The study of language fosters a respect for diversity, a respect for ethnicity and really a respect for language," Zarrow says.
passages.zh: 扎罗同意外语教育应当更早开始，但他说，学校完全可以均衡地安排计算机编程和外语学习。他建议采用沉浸式双语项目，让学生半天使用英语学习，半天使用另一种语言学习；美国各地已有几所学校成功实施了这种项目。扎罗说：“语言学习培养了对多样性的尊重、对族群的尊重，以及真正对语言的尊重。”

passages.en: O) Though the benefits of computer programming skills are vast, foreign language and coding experts agree that computer science should be negotiated into curriculums rather than replacing foreign language outright. Mandyam says the two skill sets are essential but unrelated. "Coding is an incredibly important 21st century skill for our kids to learn, and that's why we spend so much time trying to teach it," Mandyam says via email. "But I believe it is the same as or even really comparable to learning a foreign language. It would be a shame to lose something so important for the sake of adding something else, even something as important as coding. Clearly, education leaders must figure out a way to teach both."
passages.zh: 尽管计算机编程技能的益处十分广泛，外语和编程领域的专家都同意，计算机科学应当被纳入课程体系，而不是彻底取代外语。曼迪亚姆说，这两种技能组合都不可或缺，但彼此并无关联。他在电子邮件中说：“编程是孩子们在21世纪必须学习的一项极其重要的技能，这就是我们花费大量时间努力教授编程的原因。但我认为，编程与学习外语同等重要，或者说二者确实具有可比性。为了增加某种东西，即使这种东西像编程一样重要，而失去另一种同样重要的东西，将是一件令人遗憾的事。显然，教育领导者必须找到同时教授这两种技能的方法。”

statements.en: Employers attach more importance to applicants' computer skills than their language competence.
statements.zh: 雇主更重视应聘者的计算机技能而非语言能力。

analysis.锚点: 雇主更看重计算机技能而非语言能力
analysis.定位: L 段 According to the National Association of Colleges and Employers' 2016 report, study abroad and foreign language fluency were not very influential in the employee hiring processes, but 55 percent of employers looked for computer skills on applicants' resumes. 根据美国全国大学与雇主协会 2016 年的报告，留学经历和外语流利度在招聘过程中影响并不大，但 55% 的雇主会在求职者简历上寻找计算机技能。
analysis.改写: Employers attach more importance to applicants' computer skills↔55 percent of employers looked for computer skills on applicants' resumes “更看重” = “55% 雇主主动寻找”量化体现 than their language competence↔study abroad and foreign language fluency were not very influential in the employee hiring processes 比较结构的“次要一极”用否定量化呈现
analysis.辨邻: D D 段虽然写了 computer science jobs have helped boost wages in the U.S.，但讲的是宏观岗位与工资，没有触及“雇主招聘时更看重计算机技能 vs 语言能力”这一对照，只是话题相邻。 computer-related jobs hold the top seven positions in STEM fields for highest number of workers

statements.en: One U.S. state senator proposed that high school students be allowed to study either foreign language or computer coding.
statements.zh: 美国一位州参议员提议允许高中生在外语和计算机编程之间二选一学习。

analysis.锚点: 美国一位州参议员的二选一提案
analysis.定位: E 段 "I think the opportunity to give people a choice is important," says Florida state Senator Jeremy Ring, who introduced a bill last year that would allow Florida students to choose between foreign language and coding classes for the purpose of university admissions requirements. 佛罗里达州参议员 Jeremy Ring 说：“我认为给人们选择的机会很重要。”他去年提出一项法案，将允许佛州学生为大学入学要求在外语和编程课之间二选一。
analysis.改写: One U.S. state senator proposed↔Florida state Senator Jeremy Ring, who introduced a bill last year 通名→专名 + “proposed” = “introduced a bill” high school students be allowed to study either foreign language or computer coding↔allow Florida students to choose between foreign language and coding classes “either A or B” = “choose between A and B”
analysis.辨邻: F F 段虽然也提 Ring，但聚焦 The Florida bill died this year after passing 35:5 in the state Senate 这一下游事件，不再陈述“提出 either-or 提案”这一动作本身。 an identical bill will be reintroduced within the next year by others on his behalf

statements.en: Learning languages broadens students' international perspective and nurtures mutual respect among peoples, according to a high school language teacher.
statements.zh: 据一位高中语言教师称,学习语言拓宽了学生的国际视野并培养民族间的相互尊重。

analysis.锚点: 高中语言教师谈国际视野与相互尊重
analysis.定位: K 段 "Our world is shrinking but its problems are really growing," says ACTFL National Language Teacher of the Year Ted Zarrow, who teaches high school Latin in Westwood, Massachusetts, and has also studied Spanish, French, German, Italian and Greek. "We need to find a way to put ourselves at the global table and to treat each other with mutual respect. And learning languages allows us to do that because language is not part of culture, language is culture." ACTFL 年度全国语言教师 Ted Zarrow（在麻州 Westwood 教高中拉丁语，同时学过西、法、德、意、希腊语）说：“我们的世界在缩小，但问题在膨胀。我们需要找到办法让自己坐到全球的桌前并彼此尊重。学语言能让我们做到这一点，因为语言不是文化的一部分，语言就是文化。”
analysis.改写: Learning languages broadens students' international perspective↔learning languages allows us to do that “拓宽国际视野”= “让我们坐到全球桌前” nurtures mutual respect among peoples↔treat each other with mutual respect “mutual respect”原词复现 according to a high school language teacher↔teaches high school Latin in Westwood, Massachusetts 通名身份对应专名身份
analysis.辨邻: N N 段同样提到 Zarrow 与“respect”，但讨论的是 The study of language fosters a respect for diversity, a respect for ethnicity and really a respect for language 与外语应更早开始，不是题干所指的“国际视野 + 民族间相互尊重”立场。 The study of language fosters a respect for diversity, a respect for ethnicity and really a respect for language

statements.en: One U.S. state will see to it that programming classes are taught by quality teachers.
statements.zh: 美国一个州将确保编程课程由高质量的教师授课。

analysis.锚点: 某州保障编程课由高质量教师任教
analysis.定位: G 段 Instead, the state will provide support for higher quality certified teachers for programming classes. 相反，肯塔基州将为编程课提供更高水平的认证教师作为支持。
analysis.改写: One U.S. state will see to it↔the state will provide support “see to it” = “provide support / 出面保障” programming classes are taught by quality teachers↔higher quality certified teachers for programming classes “质量教师 + 编程课”名词搭配的主被动改写
analysis.辨邻: C C 段 a lack of skills training for teachers 讲的是当前缺乏师资培训这一现状，并未承诺由谁出面去保障“quality teachers for programming classes”。 a lack of skills training for teachers

statements.en: Statistics show while computer-related jobs have been on the rise, foreign languages have become less appealing to American students since mid-1990s.
statements.zh: 统计数据显示,虽然与计算机相关的工作岗位一直在增加,但自20世纪90年代中期以来外语对美国学生的吸引力已经下降。

analysis.锚点: 1990 年代中期以来外语吸引力下降的统计
analysis.定位: D 段 According to the 2016 U.S. News/Raytheon STEM Index, computer science jobs have helped boost wages in the U.S., and computer-related jobs hold the top seven positions in STEM fields for highest number of workers. Foreign language interest, on the other hand, is declining for the first time since 1995. 根据 2016 年 U.S. News/Raytheon STEM 指数，计算机科学岗位推高了美国工资，且计算机相关岗位在 STEM 领域中占据了从业人数最多的前七位。另一方面，外语兴趣自 1995 年以来首次下降。
analysis.改写: computer-related jobs have been on the rise↔computer science jobs have helped boost wages in the U.S., and computer-related jobs hold the top seven positions in STEM fields “岗位上升” = “拉高工资 + 占据高就业前七位” foreign languages have become less appealing to American students since mid-1990s↔Foreign language interest, on the other hand, is declining for the first time since 1995 “less appealing” = “interest is declining”+ “mid-1990s” = “1995”
analysis.辨邻: L L 段虽然同样涉及“computer skills”与“foreign language”对照，但时间锚是 National Association of Colleges and Employers' 2016 report 和 by 2024，与陈述句的“mid-1990s”时间锚不符。 National Association of Colleges and Employers' 2016 report

statements.en: All school subjects are said to be essential to students' well-rounded development.
statements.zh: 据说所有学科对学生的全面发展都至关重要。

analysis.锚点: 所有学科都对学生全面发展不可或缺
analysis.定位: H 段 Exposure to a wide breadth of subjects and material results in well-rounded students who are able to make informed decisions … about what they want to pursue. 广泛接触各类学科与素材会培养出全面发展的学生，他们能就自己想追求的方向做出明智的决定。
analysis.改写: All school subjects are said to be essential↔We teach algebra because it's important and we should teach foreign language and coding for the same reason 由具体到全称的概括上位 students' well-rounded development↔Exposure to a wide breadth of subjects and material results in well-rounded students “well-rounded”原词复现
analysis.辨邻: O O 段 Coding is an incredibly important 21st century skill 与 learning a foreign language 强调“两者皆重要”，并未提出“所有学科都对全面发展不可或缺”这一全称命题，与题干的“All school subjects”范围不符。 the two skill sets are essential but unrelated

statements.en: There is consensus among most educators that coding should be taught in schools but should not replace foreign language.
statements.zh: 大多数教育工作者一致认为学校应该教授编程,但不应取代外语。

analysis.锚点: 教育者就“加编程但不取代外语”的共识
analysis.定位: B 段 When it comes to allowing coding to fill foreign language requirements, though, most educators agree: Coding should be added to curriculums, but not at the expense of foreign language classes. 不过，谈到让编程顶替外语要求时，大多数教育者达成共识：编程应被加入课程，但不能以牺牲外语课为代价。
analysis.改写: consensus among most educators↔most educators agree 动词→名词的名词化改写 coding should be taught in schools but should not replace foreign language↔Coding should be added to curriculums, but not at the expense of foreign language classes “not at the expense of” = “not replace”
analysis.辨邻: O O 段虽然立场相近 computer science should be negotiated into curriculums rather than replacing foreign language outright，但表达者是 foreign language and coding experts agree，与题干“most educators”的身份锚不符。 foreign language and coding experts agree that computer science should be negotiated into curriculums rather than replacing foreign language outright

statements.en: One study showed that foreign language learning improved students' academic performance.
statements.zh: 一项研究表明,外语学习提高了学生的学业成绩。

analysis.锚点: 一项研究表明外语学习提升学业表现
analysis.定位: J 段 A 2007 study showed that foreign language students outperformed their non-foreign language peers on standardized tests after only two to three years of study. 2007 年的一项研究表明，外语学生仅在两到三年的学习后，就在标准化考试中胜过非外语学生。
analysis.改写: One study showed↔A 2007 study showed 通称研究→具体年份研究 foreign language learning improved students' academic performance↔foreign language students outperformed their non-foreign language peers on standardized tests after only two to three years of study “提升学业表现” = “在标准化考试中胜出”
analysis.辨邻: L L 段的 National Association of Colleges and Employers' 2016 report 讨论的是招聘中雇主对计算机技能的偏好，并非外语学习对学业表现的影响。 study abroad and foreign language fluency were not very influential in the employee hiring processes

statements.en: Being short of funding and qualified teachers, schools lag behind the fast developing computer science field.
statements.zh: 由于缺乏资金和合格的教师,学校落后于快速发展的计算机科学领域。

analysis.锚点: 学校因缺钱缺合格教师而落后于计算机科学
analysis.定位: C 段 The computer science field is growing faster than schools can keep up because of budget constraints and a lack of skills training for teachers. 由于预算紧张和教师技能培训不足，计算机科学领域的发展速度超过了学校所能跟上的速度。
analysis.改写: Being short of funding and qualified teachers↔budget constraints and a lack of skills training for teachers “缺资金 + 缺合格教师”同义替换 schools lag behind the fast developing computer science field↔The computer science field is growing faster than schools can keep up “落后于” = “跟不上”的句式重构
analysis.辨邻: G G 段 higher quality certified teachers for programming classes 讲的是某州出面保障教师，对应 39 题，而不是 44 题“因缺资金缺教师而落后”的现状陈述。 the state will provide support for higher quality certified teachers for programming classes

statements.en: A distinguished high school language teacher also believes it is advisable to start learning a foreign language at an earlier age.
statements.zh: 一位杰出的高中语言教师也认为更早开始学习外语是明智的。

analysis.锚点: 一位知名高中语言教师认同外语应更早学
analysis.定位: N 段 Zarrow agrees that foreign language education should begin earlier, but says it is possible to work both computer programming and foreign language learning into schools evenly. Zarrow 同意外语教育应更早开始，但表示可以把编程与外语学习都均衡地纳入学校课程。
analysis.改写: A distinguished high school language teacher↔Zarrow agrees that foreign language education should begin earlier “知名高中语言教师” = Zarrow（ACTFL 年度教师） also believes it is advisable to start learning a foreign language at an earlier age↔Zarrow agrees that foreign language education should begin earlier “also believes” = “agrees” + “earlier age” = “begin earlier”
analysis.辨邻: M M 段 I just think it's something you have to start early and not just have something that you do for a couple of years in high school 是 Ring 先提出“早学”立场，但 Ring 是参议员而非“high school language teacher”，且与题干 also 的“附议者”关系不符。 I just think it's something you have to start early K K 段虽然也是 Zarrow 出场，但谈的是 put ourselves at the global table and to treat each other with mutual respect，并未表达“外语教育应更早开始”这一立场。 learning languages allows us to do that because language is not part of culture, language is culture

reading1.title: 2022年9月·第1套 英语六级阅读理解（四选一） 第 1 篇 · 46–50 题答案与解析

passages.en: The U.S. and China don't agree on much these days. Germany and France share a border and a currency but are frequently at odds. The U.K. and India like to march to their own drum. But there's one issue on which all these countries see eye to eye: Technology companies are too big, too powerful, and too profitable. And that power is only likely to intensify, leaving governments with no choice but to confront it head-on by taking the companies to court, passing new competition laws, and perhaps even breaking up the tech giants.
passages.zh: 如今，美国和中国在许多问题上都无法达成一致。德国和法国接壤，共用一种货币，但两国经常意见相左。英国和印度喜欢按照自己的节奏行事。但有一个问题，这些国家都看法一致：科技公司规模太大、力量太强、利润太高。而且，这种力量很可能只会进一步增强，使各国政府别无选择，只能正面应对，通过将这些公司告上法庭、制定新的竞争法，甚至可能拆分科技巨头。

passages.en: China is the latest to implement an anti-trust crackdown, unveiling anti-monopoly rules last month. The draft rules followed the surprise suspension of a $37 billion stock offering by billionaire Jack Ma's Ant Group Co., making clear that no company can evade the government's regulation. The moves in China coincide with accelerating efforts in the U.S. and Europe to rein in Amazon.com, Apple, Facebook, and Google.
passages.zh: 中国是最新一个实施反垄断整治的国家，于上月公布了反垄断规定。这些规定草案出台之前，亿万富翁马云旗下蚂蚁集团公司一项规模达370亿美元的股票发行计划突然被叫停，这表明任何公司都无法逃避政府监管。中国采取这些措施的同时，美国和欧洲也在加快遏制亚马逊、苹果、脸书和谷歌的行动。

passages.en: "The big get bigger and bigger but without being better," says Andreas Schwab, a German member of the European Parliament who championed a 2014 resolution to break up Google. "Growing economic power, growing influence on local markets all over the world, and a growing concern of competitors and consumers altogether have made it happen now."
passages.zh: “大公司变得越来越大，却没有变得更好，”德国欧洲议会议员安德烈亚斯·施瓦布说。他曾推动欧洲议会于2014年通过拆分谷歌的决议。“不断增长的经济实力、对世界各地本地市场日益扩大的影响力，以及竞争者和消费者日益加重的担忧，共同促成了如今的局面。”

passages.en: In this new anti-trust era, the old focus on pricing power no longer applies, because several of the biggest tech companies have established trillion-dollar monopolies by charging consumers next to nothing. Tech giants are increasingly assuming powerful positions in banking, finance, advertising, retail, and other markets that force smaller businesses to rely on their platforms to reach customers.
passages.zh: 在这个新的反垄断时代，过去对定价权的关注已不再适用，因为几家最大的科技公司通过向消费者收取几乎为零的费用，建立起了万亿美元级的垄断地位。科技巨头正日益在银行业、金融、广告、零售及其他市场占据强势地位，迫使规模较小的企业依赖它们的平台来接触客户。

passages.en: For years, Europe alone confronted the power of digital giants. Governments were alarmed that European companies were failing to match Silicon Valley's innovations or to stop Google and Facebook from vacuuming up personal data and, with that, advertising revenue. Led by Margrethe Vestager, the European Union's competition chief, countries have sought to police the market and encourage fair play.
passages.zh: 多年来，只有欧洲在应对数字巨头的力量。各国政府担心，欧洲企业无法跟上硅谷的创新步伐，也无法阻止谷歌和脸书攫取个人数据以及随之而来的广告收入。在欧盟竞争事务负责人玛格丽特·维斯塔格的带领下，各国一直在努力监管市场并促进公平竞争。

passages.en: In China the crackdown has been driven at least partly by fear that the homegrown tech industry is becoming too powerful. The country has long championed Alibaba and Tencent, but their massive accumulation of data on the Chinese citizenry is a growing concern for Beijing.
passages.zh: 在中国，这场整治至少有一部分是出于对本土科技行业日益强大的担忧。中国长期以来一直支持阿里巴巴和腾讯，但这两家公司在中国公民数据上的大规模积累，正日益引起北京方面的担忧。

passages.en: In the U.S., a new breed of anti-trust experts argues that consideration should be given to privacy, control over data, workers' rights, and the overall impact on smaller companies. And the public in general has grown increasingly skeptical of social media companies. More than 60% say the sector has a negative effect on the country, and almost half want more regulation for social media, according to a 2020 Pew Research Center study.
passages.zh: 在美国，新一代反垄断专家认为，应当考虑隐私、对数据的控制权、劳动者权益，以及对规模较小企业的整体影响。总体而言，公众也越来越怀疑社交媒体公司。根据皮尤研究中心2020年的一项研究，超过60%的人认为该行业对国家产生了负面影响，近一半的人希望对社交媒体实施更多监管。

questions.stem: What does the author say is the issue all major economic powers have to address?
questions.stem_zh: 作者认为所有主要经济体都必须解决什么问题?

options.text: How to ensure the sustainable growth of their tech giants.
options.zh: 如何确保其科技巨头的可持续增长。

options.text: How to keep the competitiveness of their tech companies.
options.zh: 如何保持其科技公司的竞争力。

options.text: How to break up the powerful giant tech companies.
options.zh: 如何拆分强大的科技巨头公司。

options.text: How to stop tech companies from gaining monopoly.
options.zh: 如何阻止科技公司获得垄断地位。

questions.判型: What does the author say is the issue all major economic powers have to address? 直接问"是什么 issue"，是对作者陈述的具体内容的提取。
questions.拆句: 主干是 What does the author say is the issue，all major economic powers have to address 是省略 that 的定语从句修饰 the issue；have to address 是"必须解决"，不是"可以解决"，程度词不能弱化。
questions.定位: P1 But there's one issue on which all these countries see eye to eye: Technology companies are too big, too powerful, and too profitable. And that power is only likely to intensify, leaving governments with no choice but to confront it head-on by taking the companies to court, passing new competition laws, and perhaps even breaking up the tech giants. 但有一个议题，所有这些国家看法一致：科技公司过于庞大、过于强大、利润过高。而这种权力只会加剧，使各国政府别无选择，只能正面迎击——把公司告上法庭、出台新的竞争法，甚至拆分这些科技巨头。

locate.en: But there's one issue on which all these countries see eye to eye: Technology companies are too big, too powerful, and too profitable. And that power is only likely to intensify, leaving governments with no choice but to confront it head-on by taking the companies to court, passing new competition laws, and perhaps even breaking up the tech giants.
locate.zh: 但有一个议题，所有这些国家看法一致：科技公司过于庞大、过于强大、利润过高。而这种权力只会加剧，使各国政府别无选择，只能正面迎击——把公司告上法庭、出台新的竞争法，甚至拆分这些科技巨头。

option_analysis.note: ensure the sustainable growth 是"确保巨头持续增长"，与原文"政府必须正面对抗、甚至拆分"完全相反。
competitiveness of their tech companies 是"维护本国科技公司的竞争力"，原文谈的是"限制巨头权力"，竞争力≠垄断权力，主语对象与目标都被偷换。
break up the powerful giant tech companies 仅是原文列举对抗手段中的一项 perhaps even breaking up the tech giants，且原文用 perhaps even (甚至) 表示这只是极端可选项，不是"必须解决的 issue"本身。
预判"必须阻止科技公司权力进一步膨胀/取得垄断地位"与 How to stop tech companies from gaining monopoly 在主谓宾三层 (政府-stop-巨头取得垄断) 上一一对应。

pairs.orig: Technology companies are too big, too powerful, and too profitable
confront it head-on by taking the companies to court, passing new competition laws, and perhaps even breaking up the tech giants

questions.stem: What does the suspension of Ant Group Co.'s stock offering suggest?
questions.stem_zh: 蚂蚁集团股票发行的暂停说明了什么?

options.text: All attempts to evade regulation are doomed to failure.
options.zh: 所有逃避监管的尝试都注定失败。

options.text: All attempts to monopolize sales must be cracked down.
options.zh: 所有垄断销售的尝试都必须被打击。

options.text: All companies must be regulated by the government.
options.zh: 所有公司都必须受到政府监管。

options.text: All companies, domestic or foreign, are created equal.
options.zh: 所有公司,无论国内还是国外,都是平等的。

questions.判型: What does the suspension of Ant Group Co.'s stock offering suggest? 含 suggest，问"该事件暗示什么"，是要求基于事实做一步逻辑延伸。
questions.拆句: 主干 What does the suspension suggest；of Ant Group Co.'s stock offering 是介词短语修饰 suspension。注意 stock offering 是"股票发行"，整个主语是"蚂蚁集团股票发行被暂停"这一事件本身。
questions.定位: P2 The draft rules followed the surprise suspension of a $37 billion stock offering by billionaire Jack Ma's Ant Group Co., making clear that no company can evade the government's regulation. 新规草案紧随蚂蚁集团 370 亿美元股票发行被突然叫停之后出台，明确表示任何公司都不能逃避政府监管。

locate.en: The draft rules followed the surprise suspension of a $37 billion stock offering by billionaire Jack Ma's Ant Group Co., making clear that no company can evade the government's regulation.
locate.zh: 新规草案紧随蚂蚁集团 370 亿美元股票发行被突然叫停之后出台，明确表示任何公司都不能逃避政府监管。

option_analysis.note: All attempts to evade regulation are doomed to failure 把原文"不能逃避"延伸为"所有逃避企图必然失败"，多走了"企图必败"这一步，且原文没说"企图"这一主体。
All attempts to monopolize sales must be cracked down 把对象从"逃避监管"偷换为"垄断销售"；原文从未谈"销售垄断"，且 Ant Group 的 IPO 暂停与 monopolize sales 也无直接因果。
从预判"任何公司都逃不过监管"出发，只有 All companies must be regulated by the government 完整且对等地承接"no…evade → all…must be regulated"这一逻辑变换。

pairs.orig: no company can evade the government's regulation
pairs.opt: All companies must be regulated by the government

option_analysis.note: All companies, domestic or foreign, are created equal 谈"公司是否生而平等"，是宪法/法律观念，原文从未涉及；且 domestic or foreign (内外资) 这一区分原文也没有。

questions.stem: How are smaller companies impacted by tech giants' business expansion?
questions.stem_zh: 科技巨头的业务扩张如何影响较小的公司?

options.text: They can no longer do business independent of tech giants.
options.zh: 它们不再能够独立于科技巨头开展业务。

options.text: They are frequently denied access to tech giants' platforms.
options.zh: 它们经常被拒绝访问科技巨头的平台。

options.text: They have to change marketing strategies to keep customers.
options.zh: 它们必须改变营销策略以留住客户。

options.text: They no longer have the power to price their own products.
options.zh: 它们不再有权为自己的产品定价。

questions.判型: How are smaller companies impacted by tech giants' business expansion? 直接问"小公司怎样被影响"，要的是原文给出的具体影响，不需要做推断。
questions.拆句: 主干 How are smaller companies impacted，by 引导施动者 tech giants' business expansion；被动语态的施动者就是影响来源，找原文时要找"巨头扩张→小公司怎么了"的因果链。
questions.定位: P4 Tech giants are increasingly assuming powerful positions in banking, finance, advertising, retail, and other markets that force smaller businesses to rely on their platforms to reach customers. 科技巨头正越来越多地在银行、金融、广告、零售等其他市场占据强势地位，迫使小企业必须依赖它们的平台才能触达客户。

locate.en: Tech giants are increasingly assuming powerful positions in banking, finance, advertising, retail, and other markets that force smaller businesses to rely on their platforms to reach customers.
locate.zh: 科技巨头正越来越多地在银行、金融、广告、零售等其他市场占据强势地位，迫使小企业必须依赖它们的平台才能触达客户。

option_analysis.note: 预判"小企业被迫依附巨头平台"与 They can no longer do business independent of tech giants 是同一命题的肯定式与否定式表达，二者一一对应。

pairs.orig: force smaller businesses to rely on their platforms to reach customers
pairs.opt: They can no longer do business independent of tech giants

option_analysis.note: They are frequently denied access to tech giants' platforms 说小企业"经常被拒绝接入巨头平台"，与原文"被迫依赖平台"恰好相反——原文的痛点是"必须用"，不是"不让用"。
change marketing strategies to keep customers 谈"改变营销策略以留住客户"，原文未谈营销策略，也未谈"留住老客户"；原文谈的是"通过谁去触达客户"，主体动作完全不同。
no longer have the power to price their own products 把"被迫依附"偷换成"无定价权"。原文第四段确实提了 the old focus on pricing power no longer applies，但那是说"反垄断不再以定价权为衡量"，并非"小企业失去定价权"，主体与对象都被偷换。

questions.stem: What have EU countries done to confront the power of digital giants?
questions.stem_zh: 欧盟国家采取了什么措施来对抗数字巨头的力量?

options.text: They have imposed strict regulation over digital giants' advertising.
options.zh: 它们对数字巨头的广告实施了严格监管。

options.text: They have considered regulatory action to promote fair competition.
options.zh: 它们考虑采取监管行动以促进公平竞争。

options.text: They have limited sales of digital giants' products.
options.zh: 它们限制了数字巨头产品的销售。

options.text: They have sought to protect consumers' privacy.
options.zh: 它们寻求保护消费者隐私。

questions.判型: What have EU countries done 直接问"做了什么"，是对原文动作的提取，无推断信号。
questions.拆句: 主干 What have EU countries done，不定式 to confront the power of digital giants 表目的——回答须是"为了对抗巨头"所采取的动作，不是其他动机的动作。
questions.定位: P5 Led by Margrethe Vestager, the European Union's competition chief, countries have sought to police the market and encourage fair play. 在欧盟竞争事务专员 Margrethe Vestager 的带领下，各国致力于监管市场、推动公平竞争。

locate.en: Led by Margrethe Vestager, the European Union's competition chief, countries have sought to police the market and encourage fair play.
locate.zh: 在欧盟竞争事务专员 Margrethe Vestager 的带领下，各国致力于监管市场、推动公平竞争。

option_analysis.note: imposed strict regulation over digital giants' advertising 把监管对象限缩为"广告"。原文 advertising revenue 只是"巨头吸收个人数据并由此攫取广告收入"问题的一部分，并非欧盟监管的对象本身；选项把局部问题升格为全部监管对象。
选项 considered regulatory action to promote fair competition 把"police the market + encourage fair play"打包成"regulatory action + promote fair competition"，与预判完全对应。
limited sales of digital giants' products 谈"限制巨头产品销售"，原文未提及任何关于销售/产品限制的措施。
sought to protect consumers' privacy 是"保护消费者隐私"，原文 vacuuming up personal data 确实涉及隐私，但那是问题描述而非欧盟主要动作；本段对动作的总结是 police the market and encourage fair play 这一更上位的表达，选项以"隐私保护"代替"市场监管+公平竞争"是以偏概全。

questions.stem: What do Americans generally think of social media companies according to the author?
questions.stem_zh: 根据作者的说法,美国人通常如何看待社交媒体公司?

options.text: They are invading people's privacy.
options.zh: 它们正在侵犯人们的隐私。

options.text: They are increasingly influential.
options.zh: 它们的影响力越来越大。

options.text: They are becoming untrustworthy.
options.zh: 它们正在变得不可信任。

options.text: They are growing out of control.
options.zh: 它们的发展正在失控。

questions.判型: What do Americans generally think of social media companies 问"普遍怎么看"，要的是评价/态度极性，是态度题。
questions.拆句: generally 是程度副词"普遍/总体上"，提示答案要覆盖大多数人的态度，不能拿少数派或个别极端表态做答；according to the author 限制信息源只能是文章本身。

option_analysis.note: invading people's privacy 谈"侵犯隐私"，原文第七段未直接谈"美国公众认为社交媒体侵犯隐私"，前文 privacy, control over data 是"反垄断专家应考虑的因素"清单，不是美国公众对社媒公司的看法。
increasingly influential (越来越有影响力) 是中性偏正的极性，与原文负向极性矛盾；同时原文第七段未直接评价"影响力大小"，而是评价"影响是好是坏"。
选项 C 在极性 (负向)、强度 (becoming 渐进体) 上都与原文 increasingly skeptical 完全对偶，且不引入任何原文没有的额外维度。

pairs.orig: the public in general has grown increasingly skeptical of social media companies
More than 60% say the sector has a negative effect on the country

option_analysis.note: growing out of control 是"日益失控"——"失控"的判断超出原文。原文只说公众觉得社媒"负面影响大、需要更多监管"，并未说"已经失控"；要求更多监管恰恰说明"还可被监管"，与"out of control"相反。

reading2.title: 2022年9月·第1套 英语六级阅读理解（四选一） 第 2 篇 · 51–55 题答案与解析

passages.en: Born from the accessibility of mass air travel, modern international tourism has been popularized as "holiday-making" in regions that offer comparative advantages of sand, sun and sea. Travel is often portrayed as a tool for personal growth and tourism as an economic motor for destination countries and cities. There is a tendency to assume that tourism is good for everyone involved.
passages.zh: 现代国际旅游源于大众航空旅行的普及，并在那些拥有沙滩、阳光和海洋等比较优势的地区以“度假旅游”的形式得到推广。旅行常被描绘成促进个人成长的工具，而旅游则被视为目的地国家和城市的经济引擎。人们往往想当然地认为，旅游对所有相关方都有益处。

passages.en: Today the big bang of tourism drives over 1.2 billion tourists across international borders annually. Many popular places are literally being loved to death. Recent protests in ports of call like Venice and Barcelona against disturbances created by cruise ships show the unfortunate consequences of emphasizing quantity over quality in tourism.
passages.zh: 如今，旅游业的蓬勃发展每年推动超过12亿名游客跨越国境。许多热门景点实际上正被人们“爱”到毁灭。近期，威尼斯和巴塞罗那等停靠港针对邮轮造成的扰乱而举行的抗议，显示出旅游业一味重数量、轻质量所带来的不幸后果。

passages.en: Uncontrolled tourism development has become a primary driver of social and environmental disruption. Tourism studies provide much documentation of the many negative social impacts of tourism and resulting resentment that local populations direct toward visitors.
passages.zh: 失控的旅游业发展已成为社会和环境遭受破坏的主要驱动力。旅游研究为旅游业造成的诸多负面社会影响，以及由此产生的当地居民对游客的怨恨，提供了大量记录。

passages.en: Antagonism toward tourists typically develops in mature, heavily visited destinations. Protests in heavily visited destinations suggest that traditional tourism has overstayed its welcome.
passages.zh: 对游客的敌意通常出现在已经成熟且游客云集的目的地。游客高度集中的目的地爆发的抗议表明，传统旅游已经逾期滞留，失去了东道主的欢迎。

passages.en: Residents often become frustrated when the benefits of tourism are not felt locally. Although it can generate foreign exchange, income and employment, there's no guarantee that multinational hotel chains will allocate these benefits equitably among local communities.
passages.zh: 当旅游业带来的利益没有惠及当地时，居民往往会感到沮丧。尽管旅游业能够创造外汇、收入和就业机会，但跨国连锁酒店并不能保证会在当地社区之间公平分配这些利益。

passages.en: On the contrary, when people stay at large resorts or on cruise ships, they make most of their purchases there, leaving local communities little opportunity to benefit from tourist spending. These forms of tourism widen economic and political gaps between haves and have-nots at local destinations.
passages.zh: 恰恰相反，当人们住在大型度假村或乘坐邮轮时，他们的大部分消费都发生在那里，使当地社区几乎没有机会从游客消费中获益。这些旅游形式扩大了当地目的地有产者与无产者之间的经济和政治差距。

passages.en: In recent decades, local residents in destination communities also have found themselves negotiating new cultural boundaries, class dynamics, service industry roles and lifestyle transformations. For example, data show that tourism activity corresponds to increased social problems as local residents adopt the behaviors of tourists.
passages.zh: 近几十年来，旅游目的地社区的当地居民还发现自己不得不应对新的文化边界、阶级关系、服务业角色以及生活方式转变。例如，数据显示，随着当地居民采用游客的行为方式，旅游活动与社会问题的增加相伴而生。

passages.en: What does all this mean for the everyday traveler?
passages.zh: 这一切对日常旅行者意味着什么？

passages.en: First, all tourists should make every effort to honor their hosts and respect local conditions. This means being prepared to adapt to local customs and norms, rather than expecting local conditions to adapt to travelers.
passages.zh: 首先，所有游客都应尽力尊重东道主和当地情况。这意味着要做好适应当地习俗和规范的准备，而不是期待当地情况去适应旅行者。

passages.en: Second, tourism is a market-based activity and works best when consumers reward better performers. In the information age, there's little excuse for travelers being uninformed about where their vacation money goes and who it enriches.
passages.zh: 其次，旅游是一种以市场为基础的活动，只有当消费者奖励表现更好的经营者时，它才能发挥最佳作用。在信息时代，旅行者没有什么借口不了解自己的度假消费流向何处，以及这些钱让谁获益。

passages.en: Informed travelers also are better able to distinguish between multinational companies and local entrepreneurs whose businesses provide direct social, environmental, and economic benefits for local residents. Such businesses are in love with the destination and are therefore deserving of market reward. In the long run, being a responsible traveler means ensuring net positive impacts for local people and environments. With the information available at our fingertips, there has never been more opportunity to do so.
passages.zh: 知情的旅行者也更有能力区分跨国公司和当地企业家，后者的企业能够直接为当地居民带来社会、环境和经济方面的益处。这类企业热爱自己的目的地，因此值得得到市场的奖励。从长远来看，成为负责任的旅行者意味着确保当地居民和环境获得净正面影响。借助触手可及的信息，我们从未有过如此多的机会做到这一点。

questions.stem: What is the popular assumption about international tourism?
questions.stem_zh: 关于国际旅游业，人们普遍的假设是什么？

options.text: Its benefits may compensate for the adverse environmental consequences.
options.zh: 其益处可能会补偿不利的环境后果。

options.text: Its rapid development is attributed to people's improved living standard.
options.zh: 其快速发展归因于人们生活水平的提高。

options.text: It appeals to people in places with favorable geographical conditions.
options.zh: 它对地理条件优越的地方的人们具有吸引力。

options.text: It contributes to the economy of destination countries and regions.
options.zh: 它有助于目的地国家和地区的经济发展。

questions.判型: 题干 What is the popular assumption about international tourism 直接问"那个普遍看法是什么"，要求复述原文里被点名的那一句假设，不要求推断。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What is the popular assumption about international tourism，What is 引导特殊疑问，about international tourism 是后置介词短语修饰 assumption，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P1 Travel is often portrayed as a tool for personal growth and tourism as an economic motor for destination countries and cities. There is a tendency to assume that tourism is good for everyone involved. 旅行常被描绘为个人成长的工具，旅游业则被描绘为目的地国家和城市的经济发动机；人们倾向于假设旅游业对所有相关方都是好事。

locate.en: Travel is often portrayed as a tool for personal growth and tourism as an economic motor for destination countries and cities. There is a tendency to assume that tourism is good for everyone involved.
locate.zh: 旅行常被描绘为个人成长的工具，旅游业则被描绘为目的地国家和城市的经济发动机；人们倾向于假设旅游业对所有相关方都是好事。

option_analysis.note: 选项 A 谈"收益可以弥补不利环境后果"，但 P1 只笼统说"旅游对各方都好"，从未提出"补偿环境代价"的对比框架。
选项 B 说"旅游业的快速发展归因于生活水平提高"，原文虽提到 Born from the accessibility of mass air travel——"源于大众航空旅行的可及性"——但归因对象是"航空可及"而非"生活水平"。
选项 C 说旅游业"吸引地理条件优越地区的人"，但原文 has been popularized as "holiday-making" in regions that offer comparative advantages of sand, sun and sea 讲的是旅游业"在"那些地区被普及，并不是这些地区的人"被"旅游业吸引。
预判中"推动目的地经济"在选项 contributes to the economy of destination countries and regions 中找到对应，且 destination 一词原词重合，锁定 D。

pairs.orig: tourism as an economic motor for destination countries and cities
pairs.opt: It contributes to the economy of destination countries and regions

questions.stem: What do we learn from some studies about uncontrolled tourism development?
questions.stem_zh: 关于不受控制的旅游业发展，我们从一些研究中了解到什么？

options.text: It gives rise to an increase in mass confrontations.
options.zh: 它导致大规模冲突增加。

options.text: It incurs local residents' antagonism to tourists.
options.zh: 它招致当地居民对游客的敌意。

options.text: It inhibits the steady growth of local economy.
options.zh: 它抑制当地经济的稳定增长。

options.text: It brings in a large chunk of mobile population.
options.zh: 它带来大量流动人口。

questions.判型: 题干 What do we learn from some studies about uncontrolled tourism development 要求复述研究的结论，结论句必为原文明写，不需推断。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What do we learn，from some studies 是状语，about uncontrolled tourism development 修饰 studies 限定研究主题，句子无从句、无否定，理解上无陷阱。
questions.定位: P3 Uncontrolled tourism development has become a primary driver of social and environmental disruption. Tourism studies provide much documentation of the many negative social impacts of tourism and resulting resentment that local populations direct toward visitors. 失控的旅游发展已成为社会和环境破坏的首要推手。旅游研究大量记录了旅游业的种种负面社会影响，以及本地居民由此对游客产生的怨恨。

locate.en: Uncontrolled tourism development has become a primary driver of social and environmental disruption. Tourism studies provide much documentation of the many negative social impacts of tourism and resulting resentment that local populations direct toward visitors.
locate.zh: 失控的旅游发展已成为社会和环境破坏的首要推手。旅游研究大量记录了旅游业的种种负面社会影响，以及本地居民由此对游客产生的怨恨。

option_analysis.note: 选项 A 说"导致大众对抗增加"，原文虽提到 Recent protests in ports of call like Venice and Barcelona，但只是举例两地抗议，且这是 uncontrolled tourism development 的背景，不是"研究告诉我们的内容"。
预判中"研究记录居民对游客的怨恨"在选项 It incurs local residents' antagonism to tourists 中找到几乎一一对应的同义替换，锁定 B。

pairs.orig: resulting resentment that local populations direct toward visitors
pairs.opt: It incurs local residents' antagonism to tourists

option_analysis.note: 选项 C 说"它抑制本地经济稳定增长"，原文仅说收益分配不均（no guarantee that multinational hotel chains will allocate these benefits equitably），并未说旅游会让本地经济"不增长"。
选项 D 说"它带来大量流动人口"，原文虽提到 over 1.2 billion tourists across international borders annually，但这是"旅游业体量"的描述，不是"失控发展"研究的结论。

questions.stem: Why does the author say local residents of popular destinations often feel frustrated?
questions.stem_zh: 作者为什么说热门目的地的当地居民常常感到沮丧？

options.text: They fall victim to social conflicts and environmental disturbances.
options.zh: 他们成为社会冲突和环境干扰的受害者。

options.text: They have little opportunity to enjoy themselves on cruise ships.
options.zh: 他们几乎没有机会在游轮上享受自己。

options.text: They cannot find employment in multinational hotel chains.
options.zh: 他们无法在跨国连锁酒店找到工作。

options.text: They do not think they benefit as much as they deserve.
options.zh: 他们认为自己没有获得应得的利益。

questions.判型: 题干 Why does the author say local residents of popular destinations often feel frustrated 用 Why does the author say，是请考生复述作者给出的原因，原文必有明示原因。
questions.拆句: Why does the author say 引导原因疑问，宾语从句 local residents... feel frustrated 完整，主语后置定语 of popular destinations 限定 residents，副词 often 提示常态，无否定无让步，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P5 Residents often become frustrated when the benefits of tourism are not felt locally. Although it can generate foreign exchange, income and employment, there's no guarantee that multinational hotel chains will allocate these benefits equitably among local communities. 当旅游业的好处在本地感受不到时，居民们常常感到失望。尽管旅游业可以带来外汇、收入和就业，但跨国酒店集团并不一定会把这些好处公平地分配给本地社区。

locate.en: Residents often become frustrated when the benefits of tourism are not felt locally. Although it can generate foreign exchange, income and employment, there's no guarantee that multinational hotel chains will allocate these benefits equitably among local communities.
locate.zh: 当旅游业的好处在本地感受不到时，居民们常常感到失望。尽管旅游业可以带来外汇、收入和就业，但跨国酒店集团并不一定会把这些好处公平地分配给本地社区。

option_analysis.note: 选项 A 说"他们沦为社会冲突和环境干扰的受害者"，原文 P3 谈过失控的社会环境破坏，但 P5 解释 frustrated 的原因是经济收益分配不公，而不是"自己成了社会/环境的受害者"。
选项 B 说"他们没机会在邮轮上玩乐"，但原文 when people stay at large resorts or on cruise ships 谈的是"游客"在邮轮消费，而不是"本地居民"没机会享乐。
选项 C 说"他们在跨国酒店连锁找不到工作"，原文 Although it can generate foreign exchange, income and employment 明确说旅游业"能"带来就业，问题在于"分配不公"而非"无工作"。
预判中"没拿到应得份额"在 They do not think they benefit as much as they deserve 落地，锁定 D。

pairs.orig: the benefits of tourism are not felt locally
pairs.opt: They do not think they benefit as much as they deserve

questions.stem: How does the author say local residents in destination communities respond to tourism activity?
questions.stem_zh: 作者说目的地社区的当地居民如何应对旅游活动？

options.text: They endeavor to adapt to it.
options.zh: 他们努力适应它。

options.text: They readily adopt new lifestyles.
options.zh: 他们欣然接受新的生活方式。

options.text: They immerse tourists in their culture.
options.zh: 他们让游客沉浸在他们的文化中。

options.text: They try to upgrade their business models.
options.zh: 他们试图升级自己的商业模式。

questions.判型: 题干 How does the author say local residents in destination communities respond to tourism activity 是 How does the author say...的格式，等同于 Why does the author say，复述作者所写的反应方式。
questions.拆句: How does the author say 主问句，宾语从句中 local residents in destination communities 是主语，respond to tourism activity 是谓宾结构；in destination communities 是后置介词修饰 residents，结构清晰，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P7 In recent decades, local residents in destination communities also have found themselves negotiating new cultural boundaries, class dynamics, service industry roles and lifestyle transformations. 近几十年来，目的地社区的本地居民发现自己正在为新的文化边界、阶层动态、服务业角色和生活方式转变进行磋商和调适。

locate.en: In recent decades, local residents in destination communities also have found themselves negotiating new cultural boundaries, class dynamics, service industry roles and lifestyle transformations.
locate.zh: 近几十年来，目的地社区的本地居民发现自己正在为新的文化边界、阶层动态、服务业角色和生活方式转变进行磋商和调适。

option_analysis.note: 预判"居民在主动调适"在 They endeavor to adapt to it 落地：endeavor 抓住主动努力的语气，adapt 抓住调适的方向，锁定 A。

pairs.orig: negotiating new cultural boundaries, class dynamics, service industry roles and lifestyle transformations
pairs.opt: They endeavor to adapt to it

option_analysis.note: 选项 B 说"他们乐于采纳新生活方式"，但原文 as local residents adopt the behaviors of tourists 与 tourism activity corresponds to increased social problems 并列，说明这种采纳被作者视为社会问题，绝非"乐于"。
选项 C 说"他们让游客沉浸在本地文化里"，方向完全相反；原文是 being prepared to adapt to local customs and norms, rather than expecting local conditions to adapt to travelers，恰是"游客适应当地"，但本题问的是本地居民的反应，不是游客的反应。
选项 D 说"他们尝试升级商业模式"，原文虽提到 local entrepreneurs whose businesses provide direct social, environmental, and economic benefits，但这是作者对游客的建议"应该奖励哪类商家"，与居民是否"升级商业模式"无关。

questions.stem: What can tourists do to exert more positive impacts on the tourist destinations?
questions.stem_zh: 游客可以做什么来对旅游目的地产生更积极的影响？

options.text: Show interest in local customs and lifestyles.
options.zh: 对当地习俗和生活方式表现出兴趣。

options.text: Seek possibilities to invest in local companies.
options.zh: 寻求投资当地企业的可能性。

options.text: Use the services provided by local businesses.
options.zh: 使用当地企业提供的服务。

options.text: Give favorable comments about their services.
options.zh: 对他们的服务给予好评。

questions.判型: 题干 What can tourists do to exert more positive impacts on the tourist destinations 在问可采取的行动，原文最后两段是显式建议段，属于明示信息复述。
questions.拆句: What can tourists do 主干，to exert more positive impacts 是不定式状语表目的，on the tourist destinations 介词短语修饰 impacts；more 是 positive 的比较程度修饰，提示"更多"而非"唯一"，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P11 Informed travelers also are better able to distinguish between multinational companies and local entrepreneurs whose businesses provide direct social, environmental, and economic benefits for local residents. Such businesses are in love with the destination and are therefore deserving of market reward. 见多识广的游客也更能区分跨国公司与本地企业家——后者的生意能为本地居民带来直接的社会、环境与经济效益。这类企业对目的地怀有情感，因而值得获得市场回报。

option_analysis.note: 选项 A 说"对当地风俗和生活方式表示兴趣"，原文 being prepared to adapt to local customs and norms 谈的是"准备好去适应"，且该建议是"第一条"，而题干问的是"对目的地施加更多正面影响"，需的是更具体的对策——本地消费。

translation.title: 2022年9月·第1套英语六级汉译英（段落翻译） · 介绍春联这一春节习俗 参考译文与解析
translation.directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
translation.source_zh: 贴春联 (Spring Festival couplets) 是中国人欢度春节的一个重要习俗。春联由一对诗句和四字横批 (horizontal scroll) 组成，诗句和横批用金色或黑色写在红纸上，红色代表幸运， 金色代表财富。春联贴在大门左右两侧和门框上方。春联的诗句体现中国传统诗词的特点， 两句诗的字数相同、内容相关。横批凸显春联的主题，更是锦上添花。春联以简洁的文字描绘生动的形象，抒发美好的愿望。当家家户户贴春联时，人们就会意识到春节己经正式拉开序幕。
translation.reference_en:
Pasting Spring Festival couplets is an important custom for Chinese people during the Spring Festival. A Spring Festival couplet consists of a pair of poetic lines and a four-character horizontal scroll. Both the lines and the scroll are written in gold or black on red paper, with red symbolizing good luck and gold symbolizing wealth. The couplets are pasted on both sides of the door and above the doorframe. The poetic lines reflect the features of traditional Chinese poetry: the two lines have the same number of characters and are related in content. While the horizontal scroll highlights the theme of the couplet, it also adds the finishing touch. With concise words, Spring Festival couplets depict vivid images and express good wishes. Finally, when every household pastes Spring Festival couplets, people realize that the Spring Festival has officially begun.
【衔接】
